page.layout: One column of text under a running head, with a rule beneath it. No marginal notes. A catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: lia cum summo Pontifice in gratiam redierit.
LXXIII. J. Morinus Lud. Capello quid Buxtorffio rescripserit recenset, & alia nonnulla quæ ad Rabbinorum libros pertinent.
LXXIV. Bartholdus Nihusius J. Morino cur in provinciis unitis pauci libri e-ruditione referti ex Galliis adsportari compareant.

LXXV. J. Morinus Card. Barberino Apo-logia Domini Ferronii Canonici, & Archidiaconi Ecclesiæ Carnutensis ac Doctoris Sorbonici, cui summus pon-tifex concedere noluerat diplomata bullarum Abbatiæ Sancti Laudomari Blesensis eo quod doctor ille ob Janse-nianas opiniones apud Aulicos urbis malè audierat.
LXXVI. J. Morinus Card. Barb. congratu-latur ob triumphatos ab eo hostes.
LXXVII. Card. Barber. J. Morino. D. Fero-nii pietas & doctrina commendatur.
LXXVIII. J. Mor. Card. Barb. obsequium suum testatur.

page.notes: Line-end marks after "gratiam", "diplomata" and "obsequium" look like printer's dashes or ornaments, not hyphens, so they are left out. "LXXIX." at the lower right is treated as a catchword. The numerals of LXXIII to LXXV are italic; LXXVI to LXXVIII are roman small capitals. No page number is printed. Long s is normalised to s.
